capabilities: Search Douban for books, movies, TV and music
Show entries on an iBooks-style bookshelf
Read Fanqie chapters with per-chapter progress
Quote passages into notes with source and back-jump links
Export a chapter or a whole book
disambiguation: Not Clarivate/Ex Libris library software; it builds a personal bookshelf from Douban and Fanqie.
extras: Windows-only. The Fanqie sidecar is not downloaded or updated by the plugin and must be placed manually at bin/fqsidecar.exe. Chapter text stays out of the vault unless exported. No telemetry. GPL-3.0-or-later; not affiliated with Douban, Fanqie, Obsidian or Clarivate/Ex Libris.
intentEvidence: Search Douban (books, movies, TV, music) and add entries without obsidian-douban
problem: Obsidian cannot browse Douban catalog entries or read Fanqie chapters and pull excerpts into notes with source links.

relations.evidence: optional read-only linkage with obsidian-douban can be toggled in settings
Fanqie reading needs the optional sidecar from ex-libris-sidecar

summary: Desktop plugin that turns Douban and Fanqie entries into an iBooks-style bookshelf and quotes Fanqie passages into notes with back-links.
